title: Did you like the film?
instructions: Jo ve Ryan dün izledikleri filmi konuşuyor. Kimin ne düşündüğüne dikkat et.

script.speaker: jo
script.text: So, did you like the film last night?

script.speaker: ryan
script.text: Not really. It was too long. Nearly three hours!

script.speaker: jo
script.text: Really? I loved it. The actors were fantastic.

script.speaker: ryan
script.text: The actors were good, I agree. But the story was boring.

script.speaker: jo
script.text: I thought the ending was very exciting.

script.speaker: ryan
script.text: Maybe. I fell asleep before the end, so I don't know!

script.speaker: jo
script.text: Ryan! Next time, you choose the film.

questions.prompt: What did Ryan think of the film?
options: He thought it was too short.
questions.feedback: "Not really" pek sevmedim demek; çok uzun buldu.
questions.evidence: Not really. It was too long.

questions.prompt: What do Jo and Ryan agree about?
questions.feedback: İkisi de oyuncuların iyi olduğunda hemfikir (I agree).
questions.evidence: The actors were good, I agree.

questions.prompt: Why doesn't Ryan know about the ending?
questions.evidence: I fell asleep before the end
